lines: 谁能登耶和华的山？谁能站在他的圣所？
誰能登耶和華的山？誰能站在他的聖所？
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
谁能登耶和华的山？谁能站在他的圣所？
誰能登耶和華的山？誰能站在他的聖所？
Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
Who may go up into the hill of the Lord? and who may come into his holy place?

that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.
